name: ironchain-month
description: One month of sessions: the Merkle root of the signed workout-completed leaves.

fields.name: periodStart
fields.note: first second of the month, UTC

fields.name: leafVersion
fields.note: version of workout-completed the leaves follow

nonce: sha256(subject public key bytes ‖ "ironchain-month" ‖ "YYYY-MM") — one proof per person per month, findable by anyone who knows the key and the month
expiry: periodStart + 6 months; the issuer closes it then and the rent comes back
